Trio QML Type

A QML type that carries a shared property group.

Detailed Description

The alpha, beta, and gamma properties share a comment; solo stands on its own. Other groups exercise status sentences.

Property Documentation

alpha : double

beta : double

gamma : double

These three properties do the same work together. The shared comment that documents them refers to the ungrouped property GroupQml::Trio::solo and to a target that does not exist: BrokenTarget

See also GroupQml::Trio::solo.

font.family : string (until 7.0)

font.pixelSize : int (until 7.0)

This property group is scheduled for deprecation in version 7.0.

The font settings form one named property group.

See also GroupQml::Trio::solo.

solo : double (since 6.1)

The ungrouped property stands on its own.

It links back to one of the grouped properties: GroupQml::Trio::alpha

This qml property was introduced in Qt 6.1.

See also GroupQml::Trio::alpha.
